spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (शचते)
To speak articulately, to say or tell.
(इ,) शचि r. 1st cl. (शंचते)
To go, to move.

r. 1st cl. (सचते)
1 To wet, to moisten, to sprinkle.
2 To serve, to gratify by service.
(सचति)
1 To be connected.
2 To understand thoroughly.

f. (-चिः or ची)
1 The wife of

INDRA.
2

A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)
3 The astronomical Karaṇa or period named Viṣṭi.
E.
शच to speak articulately, aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also सचि, and सची.

m. (-चिः)
Friendship, intimacy, connexion.
f. (-चिः-ची)
The wife of INDRA.
E.
षच to be connected, aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also शचि, and शची.

ind.
Crookedly, awry, bent.
E.
षच to collect, इञ् aff.

m. (-तिः)
INDRA.
E.
शची the wife of the deity, and पति husband.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
All whether animate or inanimate.
E.
स with, चर moving, अचर stationary.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Blear-eyed.
E.
स for सह with, चिल्ल a bad eye, कन् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 A friend, a companion, an associate.
2 A minister, a counsellor.
E.
सचि friendship, वा to go or get, aff. क.

Rational.
2

Conscious, sensible.
E.
स with, चेतन intellect.

mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः)
Conscious, reflective, understanding.
E.
स with, चेतस् mind

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Clothed, dressed.
E.
स with, चेल clothes.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Active, making effort.
m. (-ष्टः)
The mango, (Mangifera Indica.)
E.
स with, चेष्टा effort.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Honest, upright.
2 Virtuous.
E.
सत् good, चरित conduct.

f. (-रा)
Turmeric.

m. (-शः)
Intellect, intellectual part or portion.
E.
सत् being, चित् intellect, and अंश part.

n. (-न्दं)
BRAHMA, or the Supreme Spirit.
E.
सत् being present, चित् intellect, and आनन्द happiness; the external source of wisdom and happiness.

m. (-द्रः)
A Śūdra, who has gone through the same ceremonies as the other classes, which though not directed by and indeed contrary to law, is in some places customary.
E.
सत् pure, and शूद्र a Śūdra.

n. (-तं)
A side glance.
E.
साचि, and विलीकित looked at.

n. (-व्यं)
1 Ministry, administration.
2 Friendship, fellowship.
E.
सचिव a friend, यञ् aff.

Crooked.
2

Standing or placed unevenly.
E.
साचि, and स्थित stood.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Made crooked.
2 Seen crookedly or tortuously, distorted, misrepresented.
n. (-तं)
Prejudice, distortion or perversion of mind.
E.
साचि crookedly, च्चि aff., कृत made.
